name: FinancialGraph portable existing-env qualification c225
command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
printf "0/1 qualification\n" > "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/progress.txt"
/home/sudingli/cq-home/financial-graph/env/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests > "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.txt"
/home/sudingli/cq-home/financial-graph/env/bin/python -m pip freeze > "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/freeze.txt"
readlink -f /home/sudingli/cq-home/financial-graph > "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/storage-root.txt"
printf "1/1 complete\n" >> "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/progress.txt"
